# JKIC Result Portal

> Student result management portal for John Kennedy International College — a Nigerian secondary school serving JSS1 to SS3. Admins, teachers, and parents access term-based academic reports.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Portal landing page.
- [Sign In](/login): Account login for admins, teachers, and parents.
- [Sign Up](/signup): Create a new portal account.

## Optional

- [Verify Email](/verify-email): Email verification step after signup.
